C = (B).below(0.5).count(by=['cluster', 'k8s.cluster.name']).publish(label='Health issues')

G = ((E/F)*100).publish(label='Capacity used %')

K = (I+J).publish(label='Total IOPS')
N = (L+M).publish(label='Throughput')
O = data('nic_rx_crc_errors', filter=filter('cluster', '*'), rollup='sum', extrapolation='zero').sum(by=['cluster', 'k8s.cluster.name']).publish(label='CRC errors')
R = ((P+Q)/Q).publish(label='Space efficiency ratio')
